cedarWorksMaterialityPolicy.purpose: Internal routing rules for review and documentation. This is a synthetic Cedar Works policy, not external accounting or legal authority.

tier.requirement: Prepare support and include in normal monthly reconciliation.
tier.approval: Close Analyst prepares; Finance Manager reviews as part of the account review.

tier.requirement: Document cause, account, cost center, and period impact before posting.
tier.approval: Finance Manager approval is required before posting.

tier.requirement: Attach a reconciliation bridge and reversal plan when the item is an estimate.
tier.approval: Controller approval is required before posting or reporting as open.

tier.requirement: Prepare an issue summary with root cause, owner, remediation date, and reporting impact.
tier.approval: Controller and CFO-role review are required before close sign-off.

rules.rule: Aggregate related items by account, cost center, root cause, and close period before applying a threshold.
Any cash-reconciliation difference at or above JPY 5000000 requires a documented bridge, even when timing-related.
Revenue cutoff adjustments require evidence of the internal revenue trigger and independent review regardless of amount.
Unresolved items remain on the close-control register until an owner and target resolution date are recorded.
